highlights: Fixed a rare case where two macro windows could open after an update
New single-instance guard ensures only one Echo Macro can run at a time
Cleaned up leftover processes more reliably on startup
Fixed a crash dialog during updates when antivirus was scanning the downloaded file
Updates now always install as EchoMacro.exe instead of version-numbered filenames
Improved reliability of file downloads on machines with aggressive antivirus
Internal build for the update pipeline overhaul
Movement keys, Jump, Hotbar slots, and Open Chat now use the same key-capture widget as hotkeys
Fixed Space key not being capturable in keybind fields
Editor hints and tooltips update live as you change keybinds
Fixed the 'ENOTEMPTY' download error when updating
HUD now shows at startup even without Minecraft open
HUD falls back to the built-in AHK renderer if the Electron HUD fails to launch
Internal test build for the update pipeline
Editor hints now reflect your actual keybinds instead of hardcoded defaults
Fixed incorrect hotkey tooltip defaults (were showing F6/F5 instead of Alt+C/Alt+D)
About tab version number now stays in sync with the running exe
